title.en: A shift with the ward pharmacist

tagline.zh: 成分不是商品名，加成不是相加
tagline.en: An ingredient is not a brand name, and additive is not arithmetic

desc.zh: 跟著杜藥師查房、做用藥整合、接門診藥局的電話、寫不良反應通報。
desc.en: Round with Pharmacist Tu, reconcile medicines, take the outpatient pharmacy's call, write the adverse reaction report.

desc.zh: 給藥五對、條碼、警示跳出來時叫藥師；5 床叫不醒的時候，第一個到的是你。
desc.en: Five rights, barcodes, and calling the pharmacist when an alert pops up; when bed 5 will not wake, you are first there.

about.zh: 桌上一碗糖果，標籤寫「低血糖急用」，吃掉的都是住院醫師。問問題比給答案多。
about.en: Keeps a bowl of sweets labelled “for hypoglycaemia emergencies”; the residents eat them. Asks more questions than she answers.

about.zh: 開出院醫囑的人。願意被藥師改。
about.en: Writes the discharge orders. Happy to be corrected by a pharmacist.

about.zh: 警示跳出來她不按掉，她叫藥師。
about.en: When an alert pops up she does not dismiss it; she calls the pharmacist.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。兩張藥單、一盒自己買的感冒藥。女兒照商品名分成三種。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Two lists and a cold remedy she bought herself. Her daughter sorted them into three by brand name.

about.zh: 很盡責。會把藥單拍照傳給弟弟，不管新舊。
about.en: Conscientious. Photographs medication lists and sends them to her brother, old or new.

role.zh: 四十六歲，昨晚入院觀察

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。輪班工作者，睡眠藥加過敏成藥加一罐啤酒，今天反應比平常慢。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Shift worker: sleeping tablet plus an allergy remedy plus a beer, and today his reactions are slow.

about.zh: 櫃台前有一位病人，手裡兩盒顏色不同的藥。
about.en: Has a patient at the counter holding two boxes of different-coloured tablets.

plain.zh: 藥裡真正產生作用的那個化學物質；不同商品名可能是同一個成分。
plain.en: The chemical in a medicine that actually does the work; different brand names can contain the same one.

plain.zh: 藥廠取的名字。看盒子分藥，常把同一成分算成兩種。
plain.en: The name a manufacturer gives a product. Sorting by the box often counts one ingredient twice.

plain.zh: 原廠專利到期後，其他藥廠依核准標準製造的同成分藥品。
plain.en: The same active ingredient made by another manufacturer to approved standards after the original patent expires.

plain.zh: 藥的型態與釋放方式：一般錠、長效錠、膠囊、糖漿。成分相同，劑型未必相同。
plain.en: The form and release of a medicine: plain tablet, extended-release tablet, capsule, syrup. Same ingredient does not mean same form.

plain.zh: 藥在體內慢慢釋放，一天吃的次數少；不能和一般錠直接互換。
plain.en: A form that releases slowly over the day so fewer doses are needed; not interchangeable with a plain tablet.

plain.zh: 兩種藥、或藥與酒精、食物一起用時，效果互相改變。
plain.en: Two medicines, or a medicine with alcohol or food, changing each other's effects when taken together.

plain.zh: 兩種都會讓人想睡的東西一起用，想睡的程度不是一加一，常常更多。
plain.en: Two things that each cause drowsiness, taken together, do not simply add up; the result is often more.

plain.zh: 藥物讓人昏沉、反應變慢；嚴重時呼吸變淺。
plain.en: Drowsiness and slowed reactions caused by a medicine; severe sedation shallows the breathing.

plain.zh: 病人對、藥物對、劑量對、途徑對、時間對；條碼是幫忙核對的工具。
plain.en: Right patient, drug, dose, route and time; the barcode is a tool that helps check them.

plain.zh: 掃手圈與藥袋，系統核對病人與藥；跳出警示就停下來。
plain.en: Scanning the wristband and the medicine label lets the system match them; an alert means stop.

plain.zh: 把所有來源的藥和實際吃法對成一份正確清單。
plain.en: Matching medicines from every source against actual use to produce one correct list.

plain.zh: 唯一有效的那一張。舊的作廢，家裡和醫院用同一個版本。
plain.en: The one list that is valid. Old versions are cancelled; home and hospital use the same one.

plain.zh: 把懷疑和藥有關的不舒服通報給安全系統；通報是懷疑，不是定罪。
plain.en: Reporting a suspected drug-related harm to the safety system; a report is a suspicion, not a verdict.

plain.zh: 由審查委員會依時間、資料與其他原因判斷藥是不是真正的原因。
plain.en: A review committee weighing timing, data and other causes to decide whether the medicine really caused it.

plain.zh: 嘴巴、眼睛、生殖器內側的濕潤組織。皮疹加黏膜破損是嚴重藥物反應的警訊。
plain.en: The moist lining of the mouth, eyes and genitals. A rash with mucosal breakdown is a warning of a severe drug reaction.

text.zh: 藥師看處方對不對，護理師看給得對不對。兩個人都在車旁。
text.en: The pharmacist checks the prescription; the nurse checks the giving. Both stand at the cart.

text.zh: 警示跳出來不是按掉。看是什麼、叫藥師、記下來。
text.en: An alert is not dismissed. Read it, call the pharmacist, document it.

text.zh: 輸入成分，不是商品名。查出來的是可能性，判斷還是要看病人。
text.en: Search by ingredient, not brand. What it returns is a possibility; the judgement still needs the patient.

text.zh: 杜藥師桌上。從來沒用在低血糖上，每天都空。
text.en: On Pharmacist Tu's desk. Never once used for hypoglycaemia; empty every evening.

text.zh: 杜藥師交班後給你的。她說：留著，不要給住院醫師。
text.en: From Pharmacist Tu after handover. She said: keep it, and do not give it to a resident.

text.zh: 睡眠藥、抗組織胺、酒精各自都會讓人想睡；一起用時效果加成，呼吸也會變淺。
text.en: Sleeping tablets, antihistamines and alcohol each cause drowsiness; together the effect is additive and breathing shallows.

text.zh: 作廢舊單、確認新單、請照顧者回述、轉傳新單。四步做完才算出院。
text.en: Cancel the old, confirm the new, have the caregiver repeat it back, forward the new one. Discharge is complete only after all four.

name.zh: 不良反應：評估與通報並行
name.en: Adverse reactions: assess and report in parallel

text.zh: 警訊先給醫師緊急評估，通報同時準備；因果判定是委員會的事。
text.en: Warning signs go to the doctor for urgent assessment while the report is prepared; causality is the committee's job.

note.zh: 查房：三個盒子，兩種成分

guide.en: Find Pharmacist Tu at the board

lines.zh: 內科病房，早上八點。杜藥師桌上那碗「低血糖急用」糖果，已經少了一半。
lines.en: The medical ward, eight in the morning. The “hypoglycaemia emergency” sweet bowl on Pharmacist Tu's desk is already half empty.

lines.zh: 今天三件事：12 床阿珠姨出院藥、5 床阿凱昨晚入院、8 床新抗生素第三天。
lines.en: Three things today: bed 12's discharge medicines, bed 5 admitted overnight, and bed 8 on day three of a new antibiotic.

lines.zh: 病房藥師的一天，從醫囑單和病人的藥袋開始，不是從藥開始。
lines.en: A ward pharmacist's day starts with the orders and the patient's own bags, not with the drugs.

lines.zh: 出院醫囑我開好了，你們改吧。
lines.en: Discharge orders are written. Go ahead and correct them.

guide.zh: 到 12 床看阿珠姨的藥
guide.en: See Auntie Chu's medicines at bed 12

lines.zh: 醫師說我今天可以回家了。
lines.en: The doctor says I can go home today.

lines.zh: 我分好了，三種藥：這個、這個，還有這盒感冒藥。
lines.en: I've sorted them, three medicines: this one, this one, and this cold remedy.

lines.zh: 三個盒子。幾種有效成分？
lines.en: Three boxes. How many active ingredients?

lines.zh: 讓我看標籤，不看商品名。
lines.en: Let me read the labels, not the brand names.

post.zh: 不同藥盒，相同成分。出院前對清楚，比回家後出事便宜。
post.en: Different boxes, same ingredient. Sorting it before discharge is cheaper than sorting it after.

note.zh: 五對與條碼；用藥整合五步
note.en: Five rights and barcodes; five-step reconciliation

lines.zh: 藥師也來跟給藥？
lines.en: The pharmacy's joining the round?

lines.zh: 藥師看處方正不正確，護理師看給得對不對。兩個都要懂。
lines.en: The pharmacist checks the prescription is right; the nurse checks the giving is right. Everyone needs both.

lines.zh: 給藥五對加條碼，我做一輪。
lines.en: Five rights plus barcode. I'll do a round.

post.zh: 警示跳出來，不是按掉，是叫藥師。你們就在旁邊，方便。
post.en: When an alert pops up you don't dismiss it, you call the pharmacist. Handy that you're standing right here.

lines.zh: 掃到第三位病人，系統跳出交互作用警示。
lines.en: On the third patient the system raises an interaction alert.

lines.zh: 先停。警示內容是兩個成分併用。我叫藥師。
lines.en: Stop first. The alert is about two ingredients given together. I'm calling the pharmacist.

lines.zh: 對。按掉警示的人，永遠不知道自己按掉了什麼。
lines.en: Right. Whoever dismisses an alert never learns what they dismissed.

lines.zh: 用藥整合五步。順序對了，就不會漏。
lines.en: Medication reconciliation, five steps. Keep the order and nothing slips.

steps.zh: 收集所有來源：藥單、藥袋、成藥、保健品
steps.en: Collect every source: lists, bags, OTC products, supplements
Check ingredient and dosage form item by item

steps.zh: 更新唯一現行藥單並請病人回述
steps.en: Update the one current list and have the patient repeat it back

post.zh: 感冒藥裡那個成分和止痛藥重複？好，出院單我改。
post.en: The cold remedy duplicates the painkiller's ingredient? Fine, I'll amend the discharge.

lines.zh: 我只是多吃了一顆過敏藥……
lines.en: I only took one extra allergy tablet…

lines.zh: 哪一種？幾點吃的？昨晚有喝酒嗎？
lines.en: Which one? What time? Any alcohol last night?

lines.zh: 一罐啤酒，睡前。然後平常那顆睡眠藥。
lines.en: One beer, before bed. Then my usual sleeping tablet.

lines.zh: 兩個商品名、一個時間、一罐啤酒。先把暴露時間線排出來。
lines.en: Two brand names, one time, one beer. Lay out the exposure timeline first.

post.zh: 鎮靜警語加鎮靜警語，再加酒精。加成不是相加。
post.en: A sedation warning plus a sedation warning plus alcohol. An additive effect is not arithmetic.

guide.en: Look at the liver at the workstation

lines.zh: 為什麼酒精會讓藥更強？看看它們都經過哪裡。
lines.en: Why does alcohol make the tablet stronger? Look at where they all pass through.

question.zh: 為什麼酒精加鎮靜藥會更嗜睡？
question.en: Why does alcohol plus a sedative cause so much more drowsiness?

answer.zh: 兩者都抑制中樞神經，又共用肝臟的代謝路徑；併用時作用加成、清除變慢，不是簡單相加。
answer.en: Both depress the central nervous system and share the liver's metabolic pathways; together the effect is additive and clearance slows. It is not simple addition.

post.zh: 教科書的濃度曲線是平均人。阿凱不是平均人。
post.en: The textbook concentration curve is the average person. Kai is not the average person.

sub.zh: 5 床叫不太醒，血氧往下掉
sub.en: Bed 5 hard to rouse, saturation dropping

lines.zh: 叫他，反應很慢。呼吸淺，血氧往下。
lines.en: He barely responds to his name. Shallow breathing, saturation falling.

options.zh: 喚醒評估、依醫囑給氧、通知醫師、停鎮靜藥
options.en: Rouse and assess, oxygen per order, call the doctor, hold all sedatives

why.zh: 過度鎮靜先顧呼吸道與呼吸，再找所有鎮靜成分。
why.en: Oversedation: airway and breathing first, then hunt every sedating ingredient.

why.zh: 呼吸淺加血氧下降，不是睡覺，是抑制。
why.en: Shallow breathing with falling saturation is not sleep; it is depression.

options.en: Give him something to perk him up

why.zh: 沒有一種藥能修另一種藥。

post.zh: 依醫囑處置中。藥師，把他所有有鎮靜作用的成分列給我。
post.en: Treating per order. Pharmacy, list me every sedating ingredient he has had.

post.zh: 三個：處方的、成藥的、還有酒精。
post.en: Three: the prescription, the remedy, and the alcohol.

lines.zh: 接下來依醫囑定時看意識、呼吸、血氧，每一次都記時間。
lines.en: From now on, per order, regular checks of consciousness, breathing and saturation, each one timed.

lines.zh: 監測表我來。床邊不留任何鎮靜藥，他自己帶來的也收走。
lines.en: I'll run the monitoring chart. No sedatives left at the bedside, including the ones he brought in.

lines.zh: 對，自己帶來的最容易漏。
lines.en: Right. The ones they bring themselves are the easiest to miss.

note.zh: 一張現行藥單；一通藥丸變色的電話
note.en: One current list; a call about a tablet that changed colour

lines.zh: 出院衛教：一張現行藥單，講給女兒聽，請她回述。
lines.en: Discharge counselling: one current medication list, explained to the daughter, repeated back by her.

lines.zh: 你解釋完，女兒拿起手機，把舊藥單拍照傳給弟弟。
lines.en: You finish explaining. The daughter picks up her phone and sends a photo of the old list to her brother.

q.zh: 女兒把舊藥單拍照傳給弟弟了。你怎麼做？
q.en: The daughter just sent the old list to her brother. What do you do?

options.zh: 作廢舊單、確認唯一版本、請她回述並轉傳新單
options.en: Cancel the old list, confirm the one version, have her repeat it back and forward the new one

why.zh: 家裡的版本和醫院的一樣重要。
why.en: The version at home matters as much as the one in the hospital.

options.en: The hospital system is correct, that's enough

why.zh: 家裡照舊單吃，系統再正確也沒用。
why.en: If home follows the old list, a correct system changes nothing.

options.en: Tell her to stop photographing lists

why.en: The problem is not the photo. It is the version.

post.zh: 所以感冒藥先不吃，因為裡面有一樣的成分？
post.en: So the cold remedy stops, because it has the same ingredient?
Yes. That is a good read-back.

guide.zh: 到護理站接門診藥局電話

sub.zh: 病人說藥丸變顏色了，不敢吃
sub.en: A patient says the tablet changed colour and won't take it

lines.zh: 一位病人領到不同廠牌，顏色不一樣，他說一定是假的。
lines.en: A patient got a different manufacturer's product, a different colour, and he says it must be fake.

lines.zh: 有效成分一樣嗎？劑型呢？
lines.en: Same active ingredient? And the dosage form?

lines.zh: 成分一樣。但舊標籤寫「長效」，新資料的劑型欄被截圖截掉了。
lines.en: Same ingredient. But the old label says extended release, and the dosage form column is cropped off the new screenshot.

post.zh: 成分相同不等於劑型相同。學名藥可以換，長效換一般不行。查清楚再說。
post.en: Same ingredient is not same form. A generic can be substituted; extended release for plain cannot. Check before you answer.

note.zh: 8 床皮疹：評估與通報並行
note.en: Bed 8 rash: assess and report in parallel

guide.zh: 找小組長問 8 床的疹子
guide.en: Ask the charge nurse about bed 8

sub.zh: 8 床新抗生素第三天，起疹子
sub.en: Bed 8, day three of a new antibiotic: a rash

lines.zh: 新抗生素第三天，身上紅疹，還有一點發燒。
lines.en: Day three of the new antibiotic, a red rash, and a bit of a temperature.

lines.zh: 幾點開始的？還有沒有別的新東西？嘴巴裡有沒有破？
lines.en: When did it start? Anything else new? Any sores in the mouth?

lines.zh: 嘴裡……我沒看。
lines.en: The mouth… I didn't look.

lines.zh: 黏膜要看。皮疹加黏膜加發燒，是警訊，不是普通過敏。
lines.en: Check the mucosa. Rash plus mucosa plus fever is a red flag, not an ordinary allergy.

post.zh: 緊急評估和通報同時進行。因果判定是委員會的事，不是我們現在的事。
post.en: Urgent assessment and the report run in parallel. Causality assessment is the committee's job, not ours right now.

lines.zh: 通報的順序。
lines.en: The order of a report.

q.en: Steps of an adverse reaction report

steps.zh: 記錄時間線與所有暴露
steps.en: Record the timeline and every exposure
Describe the rash, mucosa and temperature

post.zh: 我看過病人了，停藥依醫囑，皮膚科會診已開。
post.en: I've seen the patient; the drug is held per order and dermatology is consulted.

post.zh: 通報編號記下來，交班要用。
post.en: Note the report number; you will need it at handover.

guide.en: Search the database for similar reports

lines.zh: 資料庫裡有三十筆類似通報。
lines.en: The database has thirty similar reports.

lines.zh: 三十筆，除以多少使用人數？有沒有重複通報？
lines.en: Thirty, divided by how many people exposed? Any duplicates?

lines.zh: ……不知道。所以這是訊號，不是發生率。
lines.en: …Unknown. So this is a signal, not an incidence.

lines.zh: 對。寫進通報的備註，讓審查的人知道你看過。
lines.en: Right. Put it in the report's notes so the reviewers know you looked.

note.zh: 交班：三個病人，三個清單

lines.zh: 12 床出院，唯一現行藥單已回述；5 床鎮靜成分三項已列；8 床不良反應通報編號在單上。
lines.en: Bed 12 discharged, one current list repeated back; bed 5, three sedating ingredients listed; bed 8, adverse reaction report number on the sheet.

lines.zh: 今天三件事：成分不是商品名、加成不是相加、通報不是判定。
lines.en: Three things today: an ingredient is not a brand name, additive is not arithmetic, and a report is not a verdict.

lines.zh: 糖果拿一顆。最後一顆，不要給住院醫師。
lines.en: Take a sweet. The last one. Do not give it to a resident.

lines.zh: 我聽到了。
lines.en: I heard that.

lines.zh: 回家只看這一張，對吧？
lines.en: At home I only look at this one sheet, right?

lines.zh: 只看這一張。有新的藥，先問藥師。
lines.en: Only this one. Any new medicine, ask a pharmacist first.

lines.zh: 我要貼在冰箱上。
lines.en: I'm putting it on the fridge.

lines.zh: 值班手機在口袋裡震了一下。
lines.en: The on-call phone buzzes in your pocket.

sub.zh: 弟弟照舊藥單給媽媽吃了
sub.en: Her brother gave Mum the medicines from the old list

lines.zh: 我弟照舊單給她吃了那盒感冒藥。她現在很想睡。
lines.en: My brother gave her the cold remedy from the old list. She's very drowsy now.

lines.zh: 先不要再給任何藥。帶她和所有藥袋到急診，我通知值班醫師。舊單作廢，只留新單。
lines.en: No more medicines for now. Bring her and every bag to the emergency department; I'll alert the on-call doctor. The old list is cancelled; only the new one stays.

lines.zh: 早知道……
lines.en: If only I'd known…

lines.zh: 那是我該在白天確認的。
lines.en: That was mine to confirm this afternoon.

sub.zh: 新藥單貼冰箱上了，弟弟也收到了
sub.en: The new list is on the fridge and my brother has it too

lines.zh: 新藥單貼冰箱上了，弟弟也收到了，舊的我刪了。媽媽說謝謝。
lines.en: The new list is on the fridge, my brother has it, and I deleted the old one. Mum says thank you.

lines.zh: 回述那一步，就是為了這個晚上。
lines.en: The read-back this afternoon was for exactly this evening.

lines.zh: 夜裡的病房很安靜。糖果碗明天又會滿，然後又會空。
lines.en: The ward is quiet at night. Tomorrow the sweet bowl will be full again, and then empty again.

sub.zh: 成分不是商品名，通報不是判定
sub.en: An ingredient is not a brand name; a report is not a verdict
